requirements.description: User wants the unit near parks. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of green (74.26), rounded to 74. Only green is activated because parks are the only proximity service explicitly requested. The commercial unit typology, the 115 sqm minimum, energy class D, and the Turin authorization check are building or regulatory criteria, not proximity services.
Energy class D or better, as explicitly requested by the user (includes A1-A4, B, C, D).
The user explicitly requires at least 115 sqm of gross floor area. This is an explicit surface requirement, so it is applied directly as a >= filter.

output.explanation: Filters commercial-type properties (property_type = 'Attività commerciali e assimilabili') with surface_area >= 115 sqm, energy_class from A1 to D, green score >= 74, and within 3.0 km of the supplied coordinates (45.0677551, 7.6824892). Results are ordered by haversine distance ascending, so the nearest matches appear first. No LIMIT, no comune_code predicate, and no extra filters beyond the extracted requirements.
